sky cinema thriller.title: Jaws
sky cinema thriller.desc: Scary chiller about a coastal community plagued by a killer shark. With the summer tourist season at hand, the mayor is keen to keep the first attack hushed up. However, when an expert claims that the attacks are the work of a giant great white shark, there is only one solution - to kill the monster fish before it can feed again.

sky cinema thriller.title: Murder by Numbers

sky cinema thriller.title: Now You See Me 2

sky cinema thriller.title: The Bank Job

sky cinema thriller.title: Revolver

sky cinema thriller.title: Safe House

sky cinema thriller.title: Clear and Present Danger

Now their only hope is Ryan and fellow renegade operative Clark.

sky cinema greats.title: The Karate Kid

He then bumps into a handyman who also happens to be a karate master. The handyman teaches him martial arts and he eventually meets up with his tormentors at a tournament, but will they fight fair?

sky cinema greats.title: The Karate Kid Part II

sky cinema greats.title: The Karate Kid Part III

sky cinema greats.title: The Next Karate Kid

sky cinema greats.title: Dumb & Dumber

However, they are blissfully unaware that the case contains a large amount of ransom money for the owner's kidnapped husband. Their trip is soon fraught with disaster, especially when the kidnappers begin to pursue them across the country with the aim of grabbing the cash.

sky cinema greats.title: Police Academy

sky cinema greats.title: Police Academy 2: Their First Assignment

sky cinema greats.title: Police Academy 3: Back in Training

However, the rival academy intends to sabotage their plans by cutting their training time down to a minimum.

sky cinema greats.title: Blazing Saddles

sky cinema greats.title: Ace Ventura: Pet Detective

sky cinema greats.title: Ace Ventura: When Nature Calls
